content: Šeš halor sinno okkol edde dórmogór dongšo
Toi Isa dórmogórottu niyoli zargoide šomot hibar sahabi okkolor ekzone hibare hodde, "Ustad, so, ken šundor šundor fattor okkol edde kuṭa okkol!"

content.text: "Oi, tui ei ḍõr kuṭa okkol banaiyede dehor ne? Inor ekkan fattor o ar ekkan fattoror uwore no takibo, beggun bangi fela oibo."

content: Toi Isaye dórmogóror uṛanor muntu Zaitun faharor uwore boišše ar Fitor, Yakub, Yuhanna edde Andreas hibar fũwati ekela aššil, hitara hibare fusar goredde,
"Õne ãrare ho, in okkol hõtte oibo edde in okkol beggun furon oibode hiyar sinno ki?"
Toi Isaye hitarare zuwabe howa šuru goijje:

content.text: "Saiyo, hono honokiye tũwarare dúhat felar ne!
Kiyollahoile boute ãr namor béddori aibo, ar hoibo, 'Ãi hiba,' edde boutore búl fõtot loizaibo.
Ar zẽtte tũwara larair babute funor edde larair andeikka hóborahóbor funiba, hẽtte no ḍoraiyo! In okkol hameka goṭa foribo, kintu hetunot o šeš no.
Ek zatiye oinno zatir berudde edde ek raijjoye oinno raijjor berudde larai goribo. Ar bout zagat raṭ edde busal oibo. Kintu in okkol šude fuwa biyaibar šomot zontoronar šuru.

"Tũwara hũšiyar taikko! Hitara tũwarare bisar šobar hatot tuli dibo, hitara tũwarare sinagogot bet maribo, ar ãlla boli tũwarattu šašon goroya edde raza okkolor muntu tiya foribo. Hitarar hãse ãr babute goba diba.
Edde hár zatir hãse foila kušir hóbor tobolig gora foribo.

Kintu hitara zẽtte tũwarare doribo edde bisarot loizaibo, hetunot ki hoiba he babute age loti sinta no goijjo, kintu he šomot ze hota tũwarare howa oibo, tũwara hin hoiba, kiyollahoile iyan endilla no ze tũwara hota hoiba bolke Pak Ruhye hota hoibo.
"Báiye báiyore ar bafe fuwaindore dúha diyore moutor fõtot faṭaibo, ar fuwainde baf mar berudde tiyaibo edde hitarare kun goraibo.
Ãlla boli tũwarare beggune hingša goribo, kintu ze šeš foijjonto ṭiki takibo, hite uddar faibo.
"Tũwara zẽtte 'šorbo naša hingšar ziniš' tiya gorai no farede zagat tiya goraiyede dekor, ze foré hite buzok! Hetunot zara Ehudiyat takibo hitara fahar okkolot dai zoggoi.
Ze góror sádor uwore ase, hite hentu góror butottu hono kissu fũwati loi zaibolla nise lami no aiyok.
Ze maṛot ase, hite gar saddor loibolla uwafes firi górot nu aiyok.
Hẽtte hamilwala mayafuwain okkol edde dudor fuwaindor ma okkololla hondilla ze oibo!
Duwa goro zene in okkol šit hale no goṭe,
kiyollahoile en beši ḍõr hošṭo oibo, zin Allaye duniyaire sirišti goijje loti ei foijjonto hono šome no o, ar sarme o no oibo.
"He din okkolore zodi Allaye homai no dito, toile honokiye no basito. Kintu hitara zarare hibaye basi loiye, hitarar zoriya he din okkolore hibaye homai diye.
He ṭaimot zodi honokiye tũwarare ho, 'So, Mosi eṛe!' otóba, 'So, Mosi uṛe!' tũwara biššaš no goijjo.
Kiyollahoile hẽtte bonḍo mosi okkol edde bonḍo nobi okkol muntu aibo ar keramoti edde sinnor ham goribo zene šombob oile Allar basaigora okkolore hitara dúha difare.
"Tũwara hũšiyar taikko. Ãi tũwarare in okkol hár beggun age bare hoi rakilam.
"Kintu he din okkolot, ei mosibot farai zai bade,
"'beil andar oi zaiboi,
sande ar fohor no dibo.
Asmanottu tara okkol fori zaiboi,
asmanor šokti okkolore hafai felaibo.'
"He šomot hitara ḍõr šokti edde mohima loi Adomor Fut miyular butottu aiyedde dekibo.
Hibaye firista okkolore defeṛaibo edde duniyair ek šimattu loti asmanor šeš šima foijjonto, sairo mikkattu hibar basai gora okkolore dola goribo.
"Ḍũir gasor mesalottu ei šikkagan šiko: Hibar ḍeila zehon hail oiyore ṭũi niyole hẽtte tũwara zani faro ze, gorom hal hãse aišše.
He bafe tũwara o zani fariba zẽtte in okkol goṭedde tũwara dekor, ze Adomor Fut hãse aigiyegoi, kub hãse, en ki, dorozat hazir.
Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, in beggun no goṭibar age ei halor manuš okkolor mout no oibo.
Asman zobin šeš oibo, kintu ãr hota hono din šeš no oibo.
"Kintu he din edde šomoiganor babute honokiye no zane, behostor firista okkole o no, Fuwaye o no, šude Bafe zanede.
"Hetolla seton tako, kiyollahoile he din edde šoimoiganor babute tũwara no zano.

"Iyan oibode endilla, ek zon manuš bidešot musaferi goitto zar. Górottu baisa dibar age, hite hitar gulam okkolore hár hamor zimma gosai diye. Hite ekzon ekzon fotti gulamore ham diye, ar dorowanore seton takito hoiye.
"Hetolla seton taki fahara do, kiyollahoile góror giros hõtte aiye, ki hazinna aiye naki ada raitta aiye naki kuraye bak dedde hiya aiye, naki binna aiye tũwara hoi no faro.
Hiba atikka aiyore zene tũwarare gum zai taikkode no deke.
Ãi ziyan tũwarare hoir, hiyan ãi tũwara beggunore hoir: 'Tũwara seton tako!'"
